title: Trump Picks a Side in Texas: He Wants Ken Paxton to Beat Senator Cornyn
summary: Imagine you're in a race, and the most popular kid in school suddenly says, 'I'm rooting for you!' That's what just happened in Texas politics. President Donald Trump endorsed Ken Paxton, the state's attorney general, to replace Senator John Cornyn. This is a big deal because Cornyn has been a senator for a long time, and now he has to fight to keep his job. So, why did Trump pick Paxton? He called Paxton a 'true MAGA Warrior' who always delivers. MAGA stands for 'Make America Great Again,' Trump's movement. Trump said Cornyn is a 'good man' but wasn't supportive when Trump needed help. Cornyn had said Trump's 'time has passed him by' and was slow to back his border wall. Now, the race is on! Paxton and Cornyn will face off in a runoff election on May 26. But not everyone is happy. Some Republican leaders think Paxton could lose to the Democrat, James Talarico, in November. They say Cornyn is a safer bet. But Trump's endorsement has Paxton's supporters dancing to 'YMCA'—a song often played at Trump rallies. It's a wild ride in Texas politics, and the whole country is watching to see which direction the Republican Party will go.
why_it_matters: This shows how powerful a single endorsement can be, and how it can shape the future of an entire political party—affecting the laws and leaders you'll have when you're older.

background_read: In U.S. politics, parties hold primary elections to pick candidates for the general election. If no candidate wins a majority, the top two go to a runoff election.
President Donald Trump (the Republican president elected in 2016 and again in 2024) often endorses candidates he sees as loyal to his 'America First' ideas.

Ken Paxton, the attorney general of Texas, is a controversial figure who has supported Trump's claims about election fraud. Senator John Cornyn is a more traditional Republican who has sometimes disagreed with Trump.
Article_Structure: WHO: President Donald Trump, Ken Paxton (Texas attorney general), Senator John Cornyn, James Talarico (Democrat).
WHAT: Trump endorsed Ken Paxton over longtime Senator Cornyn in the Republican primary for the 2026 election.
WHY: Trump believes Paxton is a loyal MAGA warrior, while Cornyn has been critical and slow to back his border wall.

perspectives.description: Trump fans see this as a chance to replace an old-guard senator with a true believer who will fight harder for their cause.
Some Republicans worry Paxton is too extreme and might lose the general election to Democrat James Talarico, handing the seat to the other party.
Endorsements are part of how political leaders reward friends and punish critics, and this is just Trump doing what most politicians do.
